name: Divisor Domain and Geometric Series Parity
description: Replaces the explicit {1,2} domain with the property that the number of divisors of s_i equals s_i (which uniquely identifies 1 and 2). This is doubly reinforced by replacing the algebraic resonance condition with a requirement that a geometric series involving the two modes converges. The series converges only for s_i < 3, and converges to a non-integer exclusively when s_u != s_v. This perfectly encodes the bipartiteness requirement without explicitly stating inequalities or using polynomials, forcing the model to evaluate the calculus and deduce the structural graph properties.
